name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle Dubois is a seasoned PR professional with over two decades of experience navigating the fast-paced world of motorsports. Her journey began somewhat unexpectedly, after helping a local karting team with their social media presence in her late twenties. The thrill of the track and the challenge of managing public perception quickly captivated her. Isabelle prides herself on her ability to build strong relationships with both media outlets and the drivers she represents. 

Her approach to PR is rooted in honesty and transparency. She believes in crafting authentic narratives that resonate with fans and stakeholders alike. What sets Isabelle apart is her calm demeanor, even amidst the chaos of race weekends. She's known for her ability to handle crises with grace and maintain a positive image for her team, no matter the circumstances. Her long tenure with Target Racing is a testament to her dedication and expertise.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Isabelle is a woman of medium height with a warm smile and an approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with story ideas and media contacts.
Insists on having a cup of chamomile tea before every major press conference.
